resumen: Lying on the bench, the bar comes down to the chest and is pressed back up. It is the reference horizontal push for chest, triceps and front delts.
ejecucion: Lie on the bench with your feet on the floor and your shoulder blades pinched against the pad.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders, wrists straight.
Lower the bar to your chest under control, elbows about 45-60 degrees from the body.
Press the bar up until the arms are straight, without lifting your back off the bench.
